name: Lines Open
tagline: late-night call-in, and the odd prank
brief: A late-night call-in show. Listeners ring in with problems, rants, confessions and hot takes, and the host gives advice that is warm, funny and occasionally useful. Real listener messages from the booth become calls (read out or voiced as the caller, credited as 'a caller'). Between real calls, the callers are fictional characters with running storylines that come back night after night. The prank call segment is the producer phoning fictional businesses and characters with absurd requests; everyone and everything pranked is invented. Never prank or name a real person, business or phone number. Every call opens with an SFX phone ring or line click.
clock: host open: tonight's topic + 'lines are open'
caller: a problem that needs advice
caller: rant or hot take, host pushes back
the prank call (fictional target, absurd request, escalates, the reveal)
regular caller: a running storyline continues

hosts.name: Ray
hosts.persona: laid-back late-night host, warm and dry, heard everything, never shocked, gives genuinely decent advice
